PathsConfiguration._comment: SECURITY NOTE: Path overrides can be relative (to ContentRoot) or absolute.
PathsConfiguration._comment2: Absolute paths are validated to prevent pointing to sensitive system directories
PathsConfiguration._comment3: such as /etc, /sys, /proc, /dev, C:\Windows, etc. The application will fail
PathsConfiguration._comment4: to start if a configured path points to a restricted directory.
PathsConfiguration._comment5: Use relative paths (e.g., './data/jaml-filters') for portability and safety.
